scheme_name: Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Scheme for Micro Entrepreneurship - Transport Operator
other_conditions: Member of the AP Brahmin Welfare Cooperative Credit Society
Age between 21 and 50 years as of 01.04.2022
Annual family income does not exceed ₹1,00,000
Does not own any three/four-wheeler in the applicant’s name
Holds a valid permanent driving license
Holds a valid badge or other driver identity proof
Has not availed any financial assistance under other government schemes for the same purpose
Family members who have previously received assistance under Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Schemes are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 subsidy (25% of vehicle cost) and a term loan for purchasing a four‑wheeler to operate as a transport operator.
